everyday-movement.certificateDescription: For completing all 21 lessons across 3 modules and demonstrating mastery of movement science, habit-building, and sustainable fitness principles — drawing on frameworks from Built to Move (Starrett), Exercised (Lieberman), The Comfort Crisis (Easter), and The First 20 Minutes (Reynolds).

includes.text: Why your body was built to move — and what modern life took away
The real health cost of sitting too long and how to break it
Simple daily habits to move more without a gym or a plan
How to build strength, mobility and lasting energy

outcomeBullets.text: Why your body was built to move — and what modern life took away

ai-automation-blueprint.headingText: Complete all 28 lessons. Earn your certificate.
ai-automation-blueprint.subText: Master no-code AI automation from foundations to advanced multi-step systems. Finish all four modules and unlock the AI Automation Blueprint Certificate — proof you can build intelligent workflows that save hours daily.
ai-automation-blueprint.certificateDescription: For completing all 28 lessons across 4 modules and demonstrating mastery of AI automation — from triggers and actions through to AI agents, webhooks, and scalable operating systems.

outcomeBullets.text: Build 20+ no-code automations from scratch
Automate email, meetings, and follow-ups
Deploy AI agents for intelligent decisions
